subject.title: Feature Request: Add Skill Priority Configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill priority/preference contract for model-facing skill ordering, and what shape should own it?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing contract; it adds config, CLI, prompt ordering, truncation, and session snapshot semantics that need product/API direction before a repair PR is safe.

options.title: Design Core Priority Contract
options.body: Add a documented `skills.*` priority or preference API with schema, docs, CLI, snapshot invalidation, and tests for ordering/truncation interactions.

options.title: Fold Into Truncation Work
options.body: Handle only budget-survival and omitted-skill discoverability through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50677, leaving overlap selection to current prompt specificity and allowlists.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep the current allowlist, enable/disable, curator pinning, and skill-specific instructions model, and document that OpenClaw does not support global skill priority ordering.

recommendation.title: Design Core Priority Contract
recommendation.body: Add a documented `skills.*` priority or preference API with schema, docs, CLI, snapshot invalidation, and tests for ordering/truncation interactions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skills lifecycle/docs history and adjacent close decisions make this the clearest available product/API routing candidate.
